items.title: City Outfits
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Roleplay, hang out, or adventure in style with this fashion-forward skin collection. With bomber jackets, dresses, hipster glasses, and hoodies, there’s something for everyone. Whether your style is preppy, sporty, or casual, you’ll be the coolest kid on the block with City Outfits.

- 14 unique skins.
- By Cometry and Pathway Studios.

items.title: Isle of Birds
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Looks like you’re shipwrecked on an island inhabited by bird people. But wait a second! You've also turned into a bird! Meet all the birds living on this mysterious island and get to know their jobs, customs, and traditions, and who knows, maybe someday you’ll learn to fly too!

- 12 unique bird-themed skins
- By Varuna & Pathway Studios

items.title: Slime Agents
items.creator: Pathway Studios
